## Purpose
This file defines how Codex should work in this repository.
Treat it as a shared, committable team artifact.
Codurance software craftsmanship standards are centralized in `CRAFTSMANSHIP.md`.

## Working Style
- Read the user request and relevant repository files before editing.
- Prefer small, reviewable changes.
- Explain tradeoffs briefly and concretely.
- Run relevant checks before finishing.

## Planning and Handoff
- Use `scratchpad.md` as a team working brief when planning complex work.
- Keep updates concise and factual.
- Record blockers and decisions so another contributor can continue quickly.

## Implementation Rules
- Preserve existing conventions unless there is a clear reason to change.
- Avoid unrelated refactors.
- Do not introduce dependencies unless required by the task.
- When uncertain, state assumptions explicitly.

## Verification
- Run build/test/lint commands relevant to the touched code.
- If checks are skipped, state what was skipped and why.
